summary: Narrow conversation owner, runtime and message reads so changed conversations avoid fleet history reductions

replay.detail: The existing message window, cursor and timeline data remain in use; no stored conversation content is added.

schema.detail: Adds two partial endpoint indexes for legacy root-body message sends at store open. Schema version, projected data and digests are unchanged; older builds ignore these indexes. The volatile identity cache is rebuilt from claims.

rules.detail: No claim kind, checkpoint rule, digest or retention change.

compatibility.detail: No client contract, generated file, scope or wire shape changes.

downtime.detail: First open builds the two legacy indexes over retained message sends before serving; later opens reuse them. Normal rolling deployment applies.

manual.detail: No action is required on existing installations.

recovery.detail: The identity cache is in memory and rebuilds from existing claims after restart or projection repair.
